Office model - Remote

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist focused on evaluating LLM-based products.   • Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience with AI evaluation metrics or quality frameworks.
  • Familiarity with LLMOps or AI monitoring.
  • Interest in AI safety, reliability, and responsible AI processes.

Experiência na função.

Bom relacionamento interpessoal;

Dominio do SAP;

Inglês (será um diferencial);

Excel Avançado;

title: Regional Systems Manager
description:
Responsible for leading our technology implementation and operational efforts. This role is responsible for the strategic planning, coordination, and execution of systems integration projects, while also overseeing the company's broader IT infrastructure, security, and support functions. He/she will ensure that all technology initiatives are delivered on time, within budget, and aligned with business objectives, while maintaining the day-to-day health and efficiency of our IT environment.

IT Operations & Infrastructure Management:

  • Oversee the company's IT infrastructure, including networks, hardware, software, and cloud services, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Develop and implement IT policies, procedures, and best practices for security, data integrity, and system reliability.
  • Manage IT service desk and support functions to resolve issues efficiently and maintain high user satisfaction.
  • Establish and manage the PMO framework, ensuring adherence to project management methodologies.

Team & Leadership:

  • Lead, mentor, and motivate cross-functional teams, including internal staff, external contractors, and vendors.
  • Manage resource allocation across both project and operational workstreams.

Risk & Security Management:

  • Identify, evaluate, and mitigate risks that may affect project implementation or IT operations.
  • Develop and maintain IT disaster recovery and business continuity plans, aligned with Group policy and procedures.

Project & Systems Integration Management:

  • Lead the end-to-end implementation of technology projects, including scope definition, milestone planning, timeline development, budget management, and vendor negotiations.
  • Coordinate all project activities across different business areas, vendors, developers, systems analysts, and consultants.

Stakeholder Communication & Reporting:

  • Communicate effectively with all stakeholders, including executives, on project status, IT performance, and strategic initiatives.
  • Facilitate regular meetings and prepare detailed reports to ensure transparency and accuracy of information.
  • Act as a key liaison between the IT department and other business units.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Leadership: Ability to inspire, motivate teams, delegate effectively, and influence decisions.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders clearly and concisely.
  • Technical Proficiency: Solid understanding of IT infrastructure, cybersecurity principles, software development lifecycles, and cloud services.
  • Project Management: Proven knowledge of project management methodologies.
  • Negotiation: Negotiation skills for dealing with suppliers, stakeholders, and team members.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in systems and IT infrastructure management, IT projects implementation, preferably within services or technology companies.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing IT infrastructure, security, and support teams.
  • Strong background in team management and leading cross-functional projects.
  • Advanced English is mandatory.

title: MOTIVA I ANALISTA OPERAÇÕES DE INFRAESTRUTURA DE REDES JUNIOR
description:
Descrição da vaga

Quer mover a sua carreira na Motiva?

A Motiva é o lugar certo para o seu talento, na qual você pode escolher o caminho que deseja seguir juntamente com uma empresa que promove a melhoria da qualidade de vida das pessoas por meio da mobilidade. Nos comprometemos em construir uma cultura cada vez mais diversa e valorizamos a inclusão de todas as pessoas independente de cor, etnia, religião, idade, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual ou deficiência, promovendo um ambiente inclusivo e com equidade de oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Monitorar e garantir a disponibilidade e o desempenho dos sistemas de infraestrutura tecnológica, assegurando que todos os componentes estejam operando de forma eficiente e sem interrupções;

Realizar a manutenção preventiva e corretiva dos equipamentos e sistemas de infraestrutura, identificando e solucionando problemas técnicos para evitar falhas e minimizar o tempo de inatividade. Implementar e gerenciar políticas de segurança da informação, incluindo a configuração de firewalls, antivírus e outros mecanismos de proteção, para assegurar a integridade e a confidencialidade dos dados;

Acompanhar e analisar métricas de desempenho dos sistemas de infraestrutura, gerando relatórios periódicos e propondo melhorias para otimizar a operação e reduzir custos;

Prestar suporte técnico aos usuários internos, solucionando dúvidas e problemas relacionados à infraestrutura tecnológica, garantindo um atendimento eficiente e de qualidade. Participar de projetos de expansão e atualização da infraestrutura tecnológica, colaborando com a equipe de projetos para implementar novas soluções e tecnologias;

Documentar procedimentos e processos relacionados à operação e manutenção da infraestrutura, criando manuais e guias para facilitar o treinamento e a consulta por parte da equipe. Realizar testes de contingência e recuperação de desastres, assegurando que os sistemas possam ser restaurados rapidamente em caso de falhas ou incidentes;

Colaborar com fornecedores e prestadores de serviços, gerenciando contratos e acompanhando a execução de atividades terceirizadas para garantir a qualidade e a conformidade com os requisitos da empresa;

Manter-se atualizado sobre as tendências e inovações tecnológicas, participando de treinamentos e eventos do setor para aprimorar conhecimentos e habilidades.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você:

✅Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação, Sistema da Informação ou Engenharia de Redes;

✅Experiência com configuração e manutenção de equipamentos de rede (switches, roteadores);

✅Experiência com configuração e administração de redes privadas virtuais (VPNs);

✅Conhecimento de ferramentas de monitoramento de rede, como Zabbix ou Nagios;

✅Experiência com cabeamento estruturado, firewalls e práticas de segurança de redes;

✅Conhecimento em ferramentas de configuração e monitoramento de redes, como switches, roteadores e firewalls;

✅Familiaridade com protocolos como TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, VPNs, entre outros;

✅Conhecimentos em administração de sistemas operacionais (Windows Server, Linux), com ênfase na configuração de rede.

✅Conhecimento em serviços de conectividade de alta disponibilidade e redes WAN;

✅Capacidade de configurar, administrar e solucionar problemas de redes locais (LAN) e redes de longa distância (WAN), incluindo VPNs, roteamento e switching;

✅Capacidade de diagnosticar e resolver problemas de conectividade de rede;

✅Habilidade em criar relatórios claros sobre o status da conectividade e possíveis melhorias na infraestrutura.

Você se destaca, se tiver:

✅ Certificação em Redes ex.: Cisco CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate);

✅ Certificação ITIL Foundation;

✅ Certificação em Segurança de Redes ex.: CompTIA Security+ ou Fortinet NSE 1-3 para noções básicas de segurança de redes;

✅ Certificação em Cloud ex.: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner ou Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals.

title: Quality Assurance Director (Senador Canedo / GO)
description:
Coty is one of the world's largest beauty companies, with an iconic portfolio of fragrance, color cosmetics, skincare, and body care brands. They celebrate and foster a culture of kindness and pride themselves on offering equal opportunities. Coty believes that beauty is found in diversity and is committed to creating an environment where every talent shines, valuing the unique contributions each individual brings to the team. As part of their commitment to inclusion, all profiles are welcome at Coty.

JOB OVERVIEW

The Brazil Quality Director is responsible for the quality of all Coty production in Brazil and serves as a key senior leader accountable for end-to-end quality across the product lifecycle, from design to consumer.

The role oversees quality standards, GMP compliance for all markets served, incident management, new product introductions, vendor quality, non-conforming products, and the delivery of right-first-time results, ensuring product quality from manufacturing through delivery to customers and consumers.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Analize current end to end process from development to production against quality standards;
  • Direct Leadership Responsibility for Senador Manufacturing Quality Leader and Goiania DC quality;
  • Responsibility for Product Disposition within Brazil;
  • Responsible for Brazil Quality KPI’s;
  • Define and lead the Quality strategy for Brazil;
  • Responsible for Compliance of the Brazilian sites / TPMs and its product and the markets that it produces for;
  • Responsible for the Quality Capability development of the Site QA Leader and QA Teams in the various technical areas eg Raw Materials, Packaging, Bulk, Finished Goods and all aspects of Quality Control and including Quality Assurance;
  • Responsibility to ensure compliance of the sites to the relevant GMP Standards (RDC 48/2013, ISO 22716:2007);
  • Follow up and ensure resulting actions from the various QA processes are driven to a conclusion and that those conclusions are institutionalized;
  • End to End Quality Ownership for Brazilian products;
  • Key KPI’s – Compliance, Quality Alerts and Incidents, Right First Time, Defects, Consumer and Customer Complaints, Initiative Right First Time and Cost of Quality;
  • Responsible for the Industrialization of new products;
  • Strong Partnership with other functions for delivery of key results including R&D, Marketing, Procurement, etc.

REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Must have a degree in Chemistry, Chemical engineering, Biology, Medicine Pharmacy, Food, Public Health or Legal science or equivalen;
  • Must know Brazilian Cosmetic Regulations RDC 48/2013;
  • Must have a minimum of 10 years of Cosmetic Production or Quality Experience;
  • Operational experience within Supply Chain Manufacturing Sites;
  • Must have a background as a Quality Manager of a Production Facility;
  • Excellent communicator, being able to translate complex problems into clear solutions with strong Corrective and Preventative Actions and communicate this internally and externally as required;
  • Strong influencing skills to be the “voice” of the Consumer to the business;
  • Attention to the details, but with the ability to delegate and supervise;
  • Strong systemic approach to work to ensure that issues are fixed for good and willingness to escalate, confront and correct even the most Senior of leadership;
  • Fluency in English and Spanish required.

SOFT SKILLS

  • Calm under pressure;
  • Able to be decisive and a fearless decision maker;
  • Drives activity in others with energy, likes to get things done;
  • Data driven mindset;
  • Able to identify, rate and minimize risks;
  • Strong communication skills across various stakeholders.

Aqui na Deloitte, acreditamos que saúde e bem-estar não são apenas projetos, e sim uma mudança de cultura. Queremos que você coloque em prática todo o seu talento e desenvolva uma carreira de sucesso com a gente, com equilíbrio entre Mente, Corpo e Propósito. title: Game Operations Analyst/Senior Analyst (Graduated from 2022-2025)
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.

Main Responsibility

Support the strategy and performance of digital game operations, ensuring an excellent player experience while contributing to product evolution and monetization.

Job Description

  • Assist in analyzing player behavior and game performance to suggest improvements in retention, engagement, and monetization.
  • Collaborate on planning in-game events, update cycles, and monetization strategies.
  • Monitor real-time data to identify optimization opportunities.
  • Work alongside product, marketing, and support teams to ensure smooth operations and timely content delivery.
  • Create reports and dashboards tracking key metrics.
  • Research industry benchmarks to support strategic decisions.
  • Present insights and recommendations to internal teams, turning data into actionable strategies across departments.

Our Ideal Candidate

You are a driven and resilient professional who thrives in fast-paced environments and complex challenges. You bring:

  • Passion: A deep enthusiasm for gaming and a fearless curiosity to explore new ideas and territories.
  • Aptitude: A natural ability to quickly learn and master new skills, tools, and methodologies.
  • Drive: Unwavering commitment to overcoming obstacles and pushing boundaries to achieve your goals.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's/Master's degree completed or expected between December 2022 and December 2025 in Engineering, Business, Marketing, Digital Games or other fields
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Able to work in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid: 3 days in-office, 2 days remote)
  • Able to work in a full-time position (8 hours per day)
  • Passionate about games
  • Knowledge in Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace (Word/Docs, Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint/Slides)

Why Join Us

Join a dynamic team where you will be directly involved in high-impact strategic projects that shape the future of our games and brand. Benefit from personalized mentorship and continuous learning opportunities through close collaboration with our experienced management team. Your creativity and insights will truly matter in an environment that prioritizes your professional growth.

title: Content Operations Manager
description:
Must Apply Online. Use Form below.

Company Description

Sofia Health is a U.S.-based wellness technology company and two-sided marketplace connecting people to trusted health and wellness professionals. We support 1,000+ providers with tools for visibility, scheduling, and bookings across therapy, coaching, fitness, nutrition, and integrative health.

We are hiring a Content Operations Manager to own how content and provider visibility are planned, organized, and distributed across email, blog, LinkedIn, social media, and podcast channels .

Role Description

The Content Operations Manager is responsible for managing content operations across all major channels and ensuring providers on the Sofia Health platform are consistently surfaced through structured, repeatable systems.

This role focuses on planning, coordination, prioritization, and execution flow — working with existing content, provider profiles, and internal team members to ensure content moves smoothly from planning to publication.

The role also involves leveraging data and analytics to refine content strategies, driving engagement, and ensuring operational efficiencies in content processes.

What You Will Do

Content & Provider Curation

  • Review and audit provider profiles on the Sofia Health platform
  • Organize providers by modality, topic, availability, and seasonality
  • Maintain a structured rotation system to ensure fair and consistent exposure
  • Select providers and content to feature based on campaigns and priorities

Cross-Channel Content Management

  • Plan and coordinate content across:
  • Email marketing
  • Blog
  • LinkedIn
  • Social media
  • Podcast promotions
  • Build weekly and monthly content plans aligning providers, topics, and channels
  • Ensure content is accurate, current, and aligned across all surfaces

Podcast & Media Coordination

  • Manage podcast promotion workflows, including:
  • Episode launch coordination
  • Provider or guest features
  • Cross-posting to email, blog, and social channels
  • Ensure podcast content is repurposed and distributed consistently

Coordination & Execution Flow

  • Create clear content briefs, lineups, and timelines for:
  • Email upload and formatting support
  • Social scheduling support
  • Podcast and blog publishing
  • Manage handoffs between team members to ensure timely publication
  • Review scheduled content for accuracy, completeness, and coverage

Lead Awareness & Performance Tracking

  • Monitor inbound interest generated from content
  • Flag provider-related leads and opportunities for follow-up
  • Track engagement and performance across channels
  • Identify patterns in what drives clicks, inquiries, and bookings

Who You Are

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Comfortable managing content across multiple channels at scale
  • Strong written English (professional working proficiency)
  • Process-driven and systems-oriented
  • Able to prioritize independently and manage recurring workflows
  • Clear communicator who keeps work moving across teams

Qualifications

  • Content development and management skills, including the ability to write, edit, and optimize engaging and impactful content
  • Proficiency in content strategy and workflow management, as well as experience with content management systems (CMS)
  • Strong analytical skills with an ability to interpret data and apply insights to enhance content performance
  • Experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams, including marketing, design, and product teams

title: Product Owner
description:
ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Product Owner (PO) for the Revenue Management System (RMS) is responsible for shaping and delivering integrated solutions that support pricing, demand forecasting, and revenue optimization. This role involves managing initiatives that span data engineering, machine learning, and user-facing interfaces. In addition to gathering and managing business requirements, the PO will be responsible for overseeing the full delivery lifecycle to ensure successful execution from concept through release.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop and maintain a backlog of features and enhancements spanning data pipelines, predictive models, and RMS user interfaces.

Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities to optimize pricing strategies and demand forecasting.

Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate them into detailed epics and user stories with clear descriptions, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

Own the full delivery lifecycle of features and enhancements, ensuring timely execution, alignment with stakeholders, and readiness for deployment.

Collaborate with Data Engineering on requirements for data sourcing, integration, and quality.

Partner with Data Science to define, deploy, and iterate on ML models and pricing algorithms.

Align with UI/UX and front-end teams to ensure a seamless user experience.

Facilitate cross-functional workshops and planning sessions with business stakeholders.

Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess product success and user adoption.

Ensure accurate documentation in Confluence and Jira for themes, epics, and tasks.

Coordinate with QA to validate features and ensure delivery meets requirements.

Promote continuous iteration based on stakeholder feedback and performance data.

Drive change management and support user training for new RMS features.

Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory standards.

Identify and mitigate risks associated with process and system changes.

Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

Perform other job-related functions as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE:

Bachelor's Degree

FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Business Management, Data Analytics, or related fields

EXPERIENCE;

  • At least 3 years of experience in end-to-end product ownership, product management, or delivery of data or optimization platforms.
  • Experience working across Data Engineering, Data Science, and UI Development teams, as well with multiple stakeholders and brand Revenue Management teams.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments with cross-functional teams.
  • Industry experience in cruise, travel, or enterprise data systems is a plus.

COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Exposure to revenue management, pricing systems, or forecasting tools is preferred
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and iterative development
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, ML model lifecycle, and modern UI patterns
  • Ability to define and refine user stories across technical and business domains
  • Proficient in Jira, Confluence, and backlog management tools
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent facilitation, documentation, and analytical skills
  • Understanding of change management principles and user adoption strategies
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities
  • Strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, cross-functional environments

CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES

Add certifications/licenses (if any) here.

  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification preferred
  • Product Management or Lean Six Sigma certification is a plus

Além disso, oferecemos produtos digitais como Queima Diária, Smart Fit Nutri e Smart Fit Coach. Estamos sempre procurando novas formas de integrar tecnologia e inovação para ajudar você a ter um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. E aí, topa o desafio junto com a gente?

O que nos move todos os dias?

Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável. A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo.

O HR Business Partner será responsável por:

  • Atuar como elo estratégico entre a diretoria de Tecnologia e a área de Gente e Gestão Conduzir ciclos de Avaliação de Desempenho e Calibração, garantindo critérios claros e meritocracia
  • Apoiar as lideranças na gestão de pessoas, feedbacks e desenvolvimento de sucessores Identificar e atrair talentos com perfil de protagonismo, auxiliando o time de TA na detecção de "soft skills" críticas para o novo momento da empresa
  • Implementar e revisar processos internos para torná-los mais fluidos e menos burocráticos para os times técnicos
  • Ser voltado para uma cultura de alta performance e protagonismo, ajudando a transição de um modelo tradicional para um modelo de tecnologia ágil e inovador

Itens essenciais que não podem faltar no seu kit:

  • Formação em Administração, Psicologia ou áreas correlatas
  • Inglês avançado Mínimo de 6 anos de experiência em posição de BP
  • Ter atuado em empresas de tecnologia pura ou em processos de transformação digital em grandes grupos.

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?

Nos esforçamos para manter um ambiente descontraído, onde a opinião de todos reflete nas decisões da equipe. Trabalhamos de forma colaborativa e criativa. Estamos em constante evolução e sempre abertos a novas tendências.

title: Software Engineer, Data
description:
Title: Software Engineer, Data Eng

Level: L2 or L3

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Work setup: Initially remote until we open the office and then Hybrid (2-3 days/week in the office)

Comp: $3800-$4200 USD per month

Company

Talent Systems, LLC is the leading technology solution provider for casting and auditioning to

the entertainment industry. Casting directors and agents worldwide use Talent Systems’

portfolio of products to source and manage talent across film, television, commercials, theater

and digital projects, powering an unparalleled, global casting software ecosystem.

We are headquartered in Los Angeles and operate in the US, Canada, UK, Australia and India.

Our portfolio brands include Casting Networks, Spotlight, Cast It Systems, Cast It Talent,

Casting Frontier, Staff Me Up, Cast It Reach & Tagmin.

Job Description

We are seeking a Software Engineer, Data Engineering to join our Data Engineering team,

where you will play a key role in building and scaling the data platforms, AI/ML infrastructure,

and storage systems that power analytics, BI, and AI/ML initiatives across the company.

Working under the guidance of the Head of Data Engineering, you’ll design and implement

robust pipelines, improve data infrastructure, and collaborate closely with business and

technical stakeholders.

This role is ideal for an engineer who is passionate about solving complex data problems in

advancing our capabilities in BI and AI and other related technologies.

Data Engineering & Development

○ Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to support analytics, BI,

and operational use cases.

○ Contribute to the architecture and development of our data lake and data

warehouse platforms using Snowflake.

○ Optimize workflows for data ingestion, transformation, and storage in cloud

environments in AWS.

○ Implement data quality checks, monitoring, and observability tools.

Collaboration & Delivery

○ Work closely with data analysts, BI developers, and data scientists to understand

requirements and deliver trusted datasets.

○ Partner with software engineering teams to integrate data flows into core

products and services.

○ Participate in Agile ceremonies and ensure high-quality, timely delivery of data

features.

Innovation & Growth

○ Stay current with modern data engineering practices, tools, and technologies.

○ Contribute ideas for improving data platform performance, scalability, and cost

efficiency.

○ Take initiative in troubleshooting, debugging, and optimizing existing pipelines.

Required

○ 3+ (L2) or 5+ (L3) years of professional software engineering or data engineering

experience.

○ Strong proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala for data processing.

○ Advanced SQL skills and experience with relational databases.

○ Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake (preferred),

BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks.

○ Familiarity with ETL/ELT frameworks and workflow orchestration (Airflow, dbt,

Luigi, Dagster).

○ Understanding of data modeling (dimensional modeling, star/snowflake

schemas).

Preferred

○ Exposure to streaming technologies (Kafka, Kinesis, Flink, Spark Structured

Streaming).

○ Knowledge of data governance, lineage, and cataloging practices.

○ Experience with containerization and DevOps (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).

Soft skills:

○ Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively

in cross-functional teams from different cultures and geolocations.

○ Strong sense of urgency and ability to deliver results in a fast-paced

environment.

○ Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to quality.

○ Excellent problem-solving skills and a customer-first mindset.

○ Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively

in cross-functional teams from different cultures and geolocations.

title: Murex ERM Consultant

Resolve daily Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) issues on both functional, valuation, and pricing

Liaise with the technical team(s) -

when needed -

to resolve ERM related issues and necessary enhancements

Develop ERM Business requirements per given stream and according to Project needs as they come along

Products (IRD, CRD, EQD, FXD) management and validation

Manage day-to-day assigned project tasks to complete various ERM deliverables

Contribute and assist existing support group(s) in resolving requests or issues with ERM, VaR, P&L, Market Data, and booking issues

Analyze, formulate, propose, develop and/or contribute to overall solutions as per project deliverables

Continuous follow-up of new Market regulations/practices globally

Este papel é crucial para garantir a equidade salarial, o controle de despesas, o planejamento financeiro e a facilitação de processos de mobilidade global da empresa, além de transformar dados em informações relevantes para tomada de decisão.

Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Suporte na Análise de Remuneração: Auxiliar na coleta e análise de dados relacionados à remuneração dos colaboradores, incluindo aqueles em mobilidade global. Isso envolve a revisão de informações sobre salários, benefícios e políticas de expatriação, garantindo a equidade salarial e a conformidade com regulamentos locais e internacionais.
  • Participação em Pesquisas Salariais: Contribuir para a realização de pesquisas salariais, incluindo aquelas específicas para colaboradores em mobilidade global. Analisar tendências do mercado e fazer recomendações sobre ajustes na estrutura de remuneração.
  • Assistência na Elaboração do Orçamento de Pessoal: Apoiar a equipe na preparação e manutenção do orçamento de pessoal da empresa.
  • Colaboração no Processo de Planejamento Financeiro: Auxiliar na elaboração de relatórios e análises financeiras relacionadas aos custos de pessoal, incluindo aqueles relacionados à mobilidade global.
  • Gestão da Mobilidade Global: Prestar suporte administrativo e operacional para processos de mobilidade global, incluindo a coordenação de vistos, autorizações de trabalho, realocação, alojamento e benefícios para expatriados.
  • Manutenção de Dados e Documentação: Garantir a precisão e a integridade dos dados relacionados à remuneração, orçamento e mobilidade global, mantendo registros atualizados e precisos. Isso inclui a criação e manutenção de documentação relevante, como políticas de remuneração, procedimentos de orçamento e diretrizes de mobilidade.
  • Suporte Administrativo Geral: Prestar assistência administrativa geral à equipe de Recursos Humanos, conforme necessário, ajudando em tarefas como organização de arquivos, agendamento de reuniões e comunicação com colaboradores.

title: Price and Promotion Consulting and Implementation Manager

This involves organizing and participating in client sessions, conducting category analysis, proposing optimal solutions, and monitoring progress through measurement, reporting, and activity tracking.

Required Experience

And we don’t just talk about diversity and inclusion. We want everyone to have the opportunity to shine and perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. Please let us know how we can make this process work best for you.

Our approach to Flexible Working

At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.

We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. title: Senior AI Engineer (Python / Node.js)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.

Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor

Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Facilities Manager
description:
MISSION

Lead and oversee all Facilities operations across Corporate Offices, R&D Labs, Manufacturing Plant, and Distribution Center, ensuring safe, efficient, compliant, and cost-effective infrastructure. Drive operational excellence through strong vendor management, robust maintenance programs, and continuous improvement. Act as the key connection between local operations and global standards for EHS, Engineering, and Sustainability.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Ensure a safe work environment by promoting a strong safety culture and full compliance with legal requirements, NRs, company HSE policies, and global corporate standards.
  • Guarantee the integrity, reliability, and availability of all facilities infrastructure, including utilities, HVAC, electrical systems, water treatment, fire protection, building automation, and critical assets.
  • Lead, develop, and oversee internal and outsourced teams (maintenance, cleaning, security, reception, gardening, cafeteria, and services).
  • Manage preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance programs, ensuring uptime and operational continuity for Office, R&D Labs, Manufacturing, and Distribution Center.
  • Oversee facilities services to ensure high service levels, cost efficiency, and adherence to SLAs.
  • Lead improvement initiatives to enhance energy efficiency, sustainability, waste reduction, and operational performance.
  • Ensure compliance with certifications, internal audits, external audits, and global standards (ISO, GMP where applicable).
  • Oversee space planning, workplace strategy, building layout updates, and occupancy optimization.
  • Manage construction projects, renovations, expansions, and infrastructure modifications from planning to delivery, ensuring alignment with Capex governance.
  • Coordinate incident management, emergency response plans, fire brigade activities, and building security protocols.
  • Monitor and manage facilities KPIs, identifying root causes and implementing corrective and preventive actions.
  • Manage Opex and Capex budgets, ensuring cost optimization and adherence to financial targets.
  • Collaborate with key internal stakeholders (Manufacturing, R&D, Supply Chain, HR, IT, Security, Finance) to ensure seamless and compliant operations.
  • Ensure vendor management excellence, including contract negotiation, performance monitoring, compliance, and continuous improvement.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for facilities matters with local leadership and global functional teams.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical), Architecture, Business Administration, or related fields.
  • Experience managing Facilities operations across multi-site or complex environments (Office, Industrial, Logistics, or R&D).
  • Minimum of 5 years of proven leadership experience in maintenance, utilities, infrastructure, or facilities services.
  • Strong technical background in building systems (HVAC, electrical, utilities, fire systems).
  • Demonstrated experience in maintenance management, vendor management, and project leadership.
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements (NRs), engineering standards, and EHS.
  • Proven experience in managing Capex and Opex budgets.
  • Experience in multinational environments is strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency in SAP and Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Advanced English is mandatory.

SOFT SKILLS

  • Ownership mindset, with strong presence in operations and a hands-on approach.
  • High level of discipline, organization, and operational rigor.
  • Intellectual curiosity and continuous learning mindset.
  • Agile, creative, and solution-oriented profile.
  • Strong critical thinking and ability to anticipate risks.
  • Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams with engagement and accountability.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.

Resilience and ability to deliver impactful results under pressure.

title: .NET/C# - React (Fullstack)
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

As a .NET/C# and React Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to our platform's evolution by developing innovative features and ensuring its ongoing stability through close collaboration with a cross-functional team. This role is responsible for contributing to the full software development lifecycle, from concept and design to deployment and maintenance, while upholding high standards for code quality and performance. You will play a fundamental part in delivering a robust and scalable user experience, working in a supportive, team-oriented environment alongside other engineers and product stakeholders to bring new capabilities to life.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable software applications, ensuring code is clean, performant, and adheres to high-quality standards;
  • Work closely with multidisciplinary teams—including Product, QA, and UX—in agile settings to deliver resilient solutions that support strategic business objectives;
  • Actively participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and propose architectural improvements to optimize platform performance and reliability;
  • Provide technical guidance to other engineers on the team, promoting best development practices and contributing to team growth.

Essential Skills

  • Experience with the .NET/C# ecosystem for backend development and React for frontend in cloud-based (SaaS) environments;
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and agile methodologies such as Scrum and Kanban.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with AWS cloud platform (preferred), microservices architecture, and container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes;
  • Deep knowledge of SQL and database design for both relational and non-relational systems (Postgres, MongoDB);
  • Familiarity with building and maintaining continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipelines and DevOps practices;
  • Knowledge or hands-on experience with the Angular framework for frontend development.

About Encora

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Analista de Facilities PL
description:
Na Printi, acreditamos que cada detalhe faz a diferença, mas o que realmente importa é você, independente de sua origem, identidade ou crenças!

Somos uma empresa composta por um time diverso e inclusivo de pessoas #Printers, sempre prontas para transformar ideias em realidade gráfica. Valorizamos a pluralidade e buscamos proporcionar soluções para negócios de todos os tamanhos e segmentos, atendendo de pequenos empreendedores a grandes corporações.

Com um portfólio extenso, tecnologia de ponta, preços competitivos e prazos rápidos, oferecemos mais do que produtos: oferecemos confiança, respeito e parcerias duradouras.

Venha fazer parte dessa história de sucesso e inovação, com um ambiente de trabalho e soluções que celebram a diversidade e promovem a igualdade. A Printi é grande e, com você, seremos ainda maiores!

O Analista será responsável por garantir o funcionamento eficiente, seguro e organizado das instalações, serviços e infraestrutura física da Printi, assegurando condições adequadas de trabalho, bem-estar dos colaboradores e suporte às operações, com foco em qualidade, controle de custos e continuidade dos serviços.

  • Gerenciar e acompanhar os serviços de facilities, como limpeza, portaria, segurança patrimonial, refeitório e demais serviços gerais.
  • Planejar, administrar e monitorar contratos de prestadores de serviços, garantindo o cumprimento dos níveis de serviço (SLA), qualidade, prazos e conformidade contratual.
  • Controlar o orçamento da área de facilities, realizando acompanhamento de custos, medições, conferência de notas fiscais e identificação de oportunidades de redução e otimização de despesas.
  • Realizar o controle de ativos da empresa, incluindo inventário, gestão de mobiliário, equipamentos e bens patrimoniais, bem como a organização do descarte de bens obsoletos conforme normas internas.
  • Apoiar os processos de compras da área, incluindo cotações, negociações e interface com fornecedores.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas de Produção, Segurança do Trabalho, Qualidade e Manutenção, assegurando conformidade com normas técnicas, legais e de segurança.
  • Apoiar projetos de melhoria contínua, mudanças de layout, expansões e adequações de espaços físicos.
  • Atender às demandas internas relacionadas à infraestrutura física e serviços gerais, garantindo alto nível de atendimento aos clientes internos.
  • Elaborar, acompanhar e analisar indicadores e relatórios de desempenho da área de facilities.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Arquitetura, Gestão de Facilities ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia na área de facilities, manutenção predial ou gestão de serviços terceirizados.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de contratos, controle orçamentário, gestão de refeitório e rotinas administrativas.
  • Desejável conhecimento em normas de segurança, manutenção predial e boas práticas de facilities.

Benefícios:

  • Vale alimentação/refeição, disponibilizado num cartão flexível.
  • Restaurante no local.
  • Plano médico e odontológico Amil para cuidar de você e sua família.
  • Auxílio mobilidade.
  • PLR.
  • Total pass, para garantir um estilo de vida saudável e equilibrado, para você e seus dependentes.
  • Day off no dia do seu aniversário, para celebrar seu dia especial como merece.
  • Desconto de 20% nos produtos da Printi para você aproveitar.
  • Seguro de vida.

Modelo De Trabalho e Local:

  • Modelo 100% presencial;
  • Local de Trabalho: Rua João Ferreira de Camargo, 714, Tamboré, CEP

title: Agile Coach Senior
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Agile Coach Senior , who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will:

Principais Responsabilidades

  • 1) Kanban – Upstream (Discovery)
  • Estruturar o Kanban upstream para triagem, qualificação e priorização de demanda (intake/triage, option pool, readiness policies).
  • Implementar políticas de entrada (Definition of Ready) e critérios de seleção baseados em capacidade e impacto.
  • Facilitar Upstream Kanban cadences: Replenishment, Strategy Review, Risk Review.
  • Construir classes de serviço, limites de WIP e SLAs de discovery; conectar upstream ao portfólio/OKRs.
  • 2) Kanban – Downstream (Delivery)
  • Modelar fluxos de entrega com estados claros (e.g., design → build → review → deploy → done).
  • Definir WIP, Classes de Serviço (e.g., Expedite, Fixed Date, Standard, Intangible) e Policies explícitas.
  • Medir e melhorar Lead Time, Cycle Time, Throughput, Flow Efficiency e CFD (Cumulative Flow Diagram).
  • Promover cadências: Daily Flow Review, Service Delivery Review, Operations Review e Retrospectivas orientadas a dados.
  • 3) Coaching Multinível (Chapter, Squad, Tribe, Guild)
  • Squads: coaching hands-on; facilitação de cerimônias; remoção de impedimentos sistêmicos; melhoria do fluxo.
  • Chapters: padronização de práticas, políticas e dashboards; trilhas de capacitação; comunidades de prática.
  • Tribes: governança de portfólio com Kanban Flight Levels; gestão de dependências; alinhamento com OKRs.
  • Guilds: curadoria de conteúdo; fóruns de aprendizagem; benchmarks; roadmap de maturidade.
  • 4) Jira – Expert
  • Desenhar e manter Workflows Kanban (estados, transições, validators, conditions, post-functions).
  • Configurar Boards, Swimlanes, Quick Filters, WIP Limits, Card Colors e Automation Rules.
  • Implantar dashboards executivos e operacionais: CFD, Control Chart, Lead Time percentis, Aging WIP, Throughput trends.
  • Governar schemas de issue types, fields (custom), screens, permissions, versioning e integrações (Jira Align/Portfolio, Confluence, Bitbucket, DevOps).
  • Garantir data quality e taxonomias (componentes, labels, epics, initiatives).
  • 5) Métricas, Análise e Melhoria Contínua
  • Construir e monitorar Service Level Expectations (SLEs) com percentis (e.g., P50/P85/P95).
  • Rodar análises de variabilidade, aging work-in-progress e flow debt; conduzir ações de redução.
  • Conectar métricas de fluxo a outcomes de negócio (NPS, adoção, churn, tempo de resposta, satisfação interna).
  • Reportar em ritmos executivos: Health Check por Tribe, trend de previsibilidade, capacidade x demanda.
  • 6) Change Management & Cultura
  • Conduzir jornadas de adoção (mapa de stakeholders, comunicação, treinamento, coaching 1:1).
  • Estabelecer políticas explícitas e acordos de serviço (SLA/SLE, políticas de bloqueio, políticas de revisão).
  • Promover experimentos de melhoria (kaizens) e A3 problem solving.

Mandatory skills:

  • Domínio de Kanban (upstream e downstream) com aplicação prática comprovada em múltiplos times.
  • Experiência atuando em Chapter, Squad, Tribe e Guild (estrutura de Agile at Scale).
  • Jira avançado: workflows, automations, dashboards, control chart, CFD, governance e integrações.
  • Métricas de fluxo: Lead/Cycle Time, Throughput, WIP, CFD, Flow Efficiency, Aging WIP, percentis e SLEs.
  • Facilitação de cadências Kanban e práticas de Service Delivery.
  • Experiência com gestão de dependências e portfólio em ambientes multi-equipes.
  • Habilidade de coaching, comunicação, influência e formação de comunidades.
  • Português fluente; leitura técnica em inglês.

Desirable Skills:

  • Certificações: AKC/AKP/KMP (Kanban University), PSK (Scrum.org), SAFe/Kanban Flight Levels.
  • Experiência com Jira Align, Confluence, Bitbucket/GitHub, Azure DevOps.
  • Background em Data & AI / Produto Digital B2C/B2B, e analytics orientado a valor.
  • Vivência com OKRs, product discovery, service design, SRE/DevOps.
  • Conhecimento em Lean, Theory of Constraints, Cost of Delay e Classes de Serviço avançadas.

title: Business Analyst
description:
THE ROLE

Love building things fast and figuring out what works? Curious about AI and excited to push the boundaries of what's possible? We're looking for a Business Analyst to join our Strategy team. You'll be our rapid prototyper---turning ideas into working features, testing what resonates, and handing off polished concepts to engineering for the full build. It's part builder, part thinker, and a whole lot of experimentation.

You'll work directly with the VP of Strategy and collaborate across product, engineering, and AI teams to bring new features to life quickly. If you're resourceful, creative, and love the thrill of "let's just try it and see," you'll thrive here.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Build fully functioning feature prototypes using AI tools like Claude Code and our platform
  • Test, iterate, and refine ideas with real users before they hit full production
  • Work backwards from customer problems to design solutions that actually solve them
  • Collaborate with engineers to hand off working prototypes for implementation
  • Stay curious about AI capabilities and explore creative ways to leverage them

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • A knack for figuring things out---you don't need to know code, but you're not afraid to tinker
  • Strong product intuition and a bias toward action over perfection
  • Experience building, prototyping, or problem-solving in scrappy environments
  • Excellent communication skills---you can explain what you built and why it matters
  • Genuine interest in AI and emerging tools (exposure is a plus, enthusiasm is a must)
  • Bonus points for finance experience, but not required
  • Bonus points if you've worked with automation tools, no-code platforms, or AI assistants

Why Street Diligence?

We're The Deal Nerds making sense of complex contracts so our clients don't have to. But we're also builders who believe the best way to know if something works is to build it and test it. We move fast, we experiment often, and we're not afraid to try the unconventional approach. If you love the zero-to-one phase and want to shape how AI transforms financial intelligence, come join the crew.

title: Cientista de Dados Pleno
description:
A Privacy é a maior rede social de conteúdo digital da América Latina. Nascemos para conectar tecnologia ao poder criativo das pessoas. Somos um organismo vivo, onde cada pessoa é uma célula pulsante de abundância, liberdade e autorrealização.

Aqui, performance tem propósito, estrutura tem calor humano e ambição anda junto com ética.

Nosso produto é uma rede social líder no Brasil de monetização de conteúdo, em plena expansão internacional. Esse crescimento exige um(a) Cientista de Dados Pleno com mentalidade analítica, autonomia e capacidade de transformar dados em decisões estratégicas e modelos preditivos de impacto real no negócio.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar em todo o ciclo de vida de projetos de Data Science , desde a compreensão do problema até a entrega de modelos em produção;
  • Realizar exploração, limpeza e preparação de dados (Data Wrangling) para uso em análises e modelagem;
  • Desenvolver, validar e manter modelos de Machine Learning (regressão, classificação, clustering e séries temporais);
  • Executar análises estatísticas e testes de hipótese (ex: A/B Testing) para validar insights e estratégias;
  • Construir visualizações e relatórios claros e eficazes para comunicação de resultados;
  • Atuar em parceria com times de produto, engenharia e negócios , traduzindo achados técnicos em ações práticas;
  • Participar ativamente da construção de uma cultura orientada a dados , contribuindo com boas práticas e padronizações;
  • Acompanhar o desempenho dos modelos em produção , garantindo melhoria contínua e rastreabilidade.

O que valorizamos

Raciocínio analítico e curiosidade intelectual: pessoas que questionam, testam hipóteses e buscam compreender profundamente o problema antes de propor soluções.

Foco em impacto: profissionais que entendem o “porquê” por trás dos modelos e direcionam seus esforços para gerar valor real para o negócio.

Autonomia e colaboração: capacidade de conduzir projetos de ponta a ponta, em parceria com engenheiros de dados e áreas de produto.

Comunicação clara: traduzir resultados técnicos complexos para públicos não técnicos de forma acessível e objetiva.

Inovação contínua: curiosidade para aprender novas ferramentas e aplicar novas técnicas de ciência de dados e IA.

Requisitos

  • Domínio de Python e suas principais bibliotecas de Data Science (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn);
  • Experiência sólida com SQL para extração, manipulação e análise de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Conhecimento prático em Machine Learning aplicado (regressão, classificação, clustering, séries temporais);
  • Base sólida em estatística e testes de hipóteses ;
  • Habilidade em visualização de dados (Matplotlib, Seaborn, Power BI ou equivalentes);
  • Familiaridade com o ciclo de vida completo de projetos de Data Science (da coleta ao monitoramento de modelos);
  • Boas práticas de código e programação orientada a objetos (POO) ;
  • Experiência em ambientes colaborativos e com versionamento de código (Git, GitHub, GitLab).

Diferenciais

  • Vivência com ferramentas de Big Data (Spark, Databricks);
  • Experiência em ambientes de nuvem (AWS, GCP ou Azure);
  • Conhecimento em MLOps (deploy de modelos, Docker, CI/CD);
  • Experiência em Deep Learning (TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch);
  • Participação em projetos de Sistemas de Recomendação (filtragem colaborativa, embeddings, modelos híbridos);
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados vetoriais (Pinecone, ChromaDB) e arquiteturas RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) .

Modelo de contratação e ambiente

  • Contratação PJ
  • Hibrido — escritório na Zona Sul – São Paulo/SP
  • Ambiente colaborativo, com cultura forte , liberdade técnica e foco em inovação
  • Estrutura horizontal, com autonomia para propor, testar e evoluir soluções

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde (disponível para CNPJs com mais de 6 meses) ;
  • TotalPass – academias, estúdios e atividades de bem-estar;
  • Alura – acesso à plataforma de aprendizado contínuo;
  • Espaço para crescimento e protagonismo , com aprendizado constante e impacto direto na estrutura financeira da empresa.

Por que entrar na Privacy

Estamos construindo uma área de dados moderna, escalável e com papel estratégico no crescimento da Privacy.

Aqui, você terá autonomia para testar hipóteses, desenvolver modelos preditivos e contribuir diretamente para decisões que impactam milhões de pessoas.

Se você é movido por desafios, inovação e quer fazer parte de uma empresa que une tecnologia, propósito e impacto real , essa é a sua oportunidade.

title: Director of Salesforce Implementation
description:

The Director of Salesforce Implementation will lead a team of up to 15 Salesforce professionals across the US and LATAM, including consultants, developers, administrators, solution architects, and marketing automation specialists (MCAE and MCE). Team Leadership and Management

Project and Delivery Oversight

Operational Excellence

Cross-Department Collaboration

Required

Preferred

  • Background with project management tools such as Asana, Monday, or Wrike.
  • Experience with US, LATAM, and offshore team management.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and performance bonus structure.
  • Flexible remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to lead a rapidly expanding Salesforce practice.
  • Supportive leadership and a culture focused on growth, innovation, and client success.
  • Professional development opportunities and Salesforce certification support.

title: Customer Operations Specialist
description:
Summary

Sphere is revolutionizing global money movement by building modern financial rails with digital dollars, making transactions simple, affordable, and accessible worldwide. Through our frontend applications, APIs, low-level bank messaging optimizations, and liquidity infrastructure, businesses in emerging markets can send money across borders at scale — without depending on foreign capital or simply speaking the right languages. We combine frontier technology like stablecoins and zero-knowledge proofs with traditional banking, payments, and foreign exchange infrastructure to make global payments settle in minutes.

We’re a Seed+ startup globally distributed across the US, Brazil, Mexico, Singapore, Portugal, and the Caribbean. We’ve processed over $1B in payments volume and are backed by some of the best high-frequency trading and venture firms in the world, including TCG, Jump, Hudson River Trading, and Coinbase; as well as angels from companies like Stripe, PayPal, Brex, Visa, Revolut, Grab, Solana, Circle, and JPMorgan Chase. Our team has previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world’s leading companies (Coinbase, Vanguard, Franklin Templeton, Chainalysis, Wells Fargo) as well as at startups and accelerators like YCombinator. We’re spending the best years of our lives building Sphere, driven by a shared belief in our mission to enhance human prosperity through cutting-edge technology, creating a modern SWIFT for the 21st century and beyond.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the onboarding lifecycle of our enterprise customers, serving as their key liaison and ensuring timely setup
  • Support customers in navigating our Anti-Money Laundering requirements, including Know-Your-Customer and enhanced due diligence checks
  • Drive post-setup customer success with our enterprise customers, helping them unlock the full value of our offerings
  • Build out and manage a robust, multi-channel customer support function (email, chat), to deliver quick and effective resolutions to customer inquiries
  • Work closely with Sales & Product teams to transition customers to new product offerings or vendors
  • Proactively gather and synthesize customer needs and feedback, identifying opportunities for product/UX improvements

Requirements

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English and either Spanish or Portuguese
  • Excels at multi-tasking and rapid context switching in fast-paced environments
  • Demonstrated sense of ownership and strong project management & Organizational skills
  • Analytical, with a proactive approach to problem-solving
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills

Nice to haves

  • Prior experience in a customer success, customer onboarding or customer-facing role
  • Prior experience in Compliance, Payments or Web3
  • Knowledge of SWIFT, SEPA, ACH, wire transfers, and other global payment networks.
  • Understanding of foreign exchange (FX) processes, currency conversions, and multi-currency settlement
  • Open to working flexible hours, and extended shifts, to meet business needs

Why Join Us?

  • After years navigating the idea maze, we’ve stumbled on a previously unexplored path to exponentially boost human prosperity and make the world a fairer place. Join us in making a global impact, particularly in emerging regions that are just starting to connect.
  • Have executive level impact, responsibility, and upside in an early-stage startup that has found initial product-market fit and has been growing more than 100% per month over the last year.
  • Work on some of the hardest problems in the world, leveraging frontier technology in cryptography and distributed systems to modernize payments infrastructure from 1959.
  • Unlock exceptional growth and learning opportunities in an environment that champions ownership, ambition, and innovation.
  • Join as an early employee and help us define a world-class culture of collaboration, rationality, low ego/status, customer obsession, and output. There are rare learning opportunities, and you’ll be joining just as we start to scale.

description:
Descrição da Posição

Buscamos um(a) Helpdesk Support Analyst – Trainee para atuar no suporte técnico de primeiro nível, auxiliando usuários na resolução de problemas, abertura e acompanhamento de chamados, além de apoiar na organização e cumprimento dos níveis de serviço (SLA).   • Realizar abertura, registro, acompanhamento e encerramento de chamados técnicos;

description:
Airswift is looking for a Regional Sales Manager to work in a permanent position in Brazil for a global leader in industrial dry ice blasting, surface preparation, and industrial painting services.

This role is responsible for driving sales growth, expanding market reach, and managing relationships with key accounts in Brazil and the Northern region of South America (including Colombia, Panama, and Peru). The professional will combine business development, client engagement, and project support to ensure an outstanding customer experience and sustained revenue growth.

Job Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute a country-level sales strategy aligned with regional growth goals.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities in the power generation and industrial sectors.
  • Collaborate with clients to understand their needs and propose tailored solutions.
  • Manage proposal development, pricing discussions, and contract negotiations.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for key clients, ensuring high levels of satisfaction.
  • Build and maintain strong, long-term client relationships.
  • Represent the company in client meetings, site visits, and industry trade shows.
  • Conduct market research to identify trends, competitors, and new opportunities.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of B2B sales or business development experience in industrial services or technical environments.
  • Experience with Power Plants.
  • Willingness to travel.

Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience with CRM systems and consultative selling.
  • Knowledge of HRSG and Thermal Engineering.

Location: Brazil

Employment Type: Permanent

Travel: Regional travel required

title: Global Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as University of São Paulo, UNICAMP and UNESP. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.

The Role

We are seeking a proactive, results-oriented Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our global HR team. In this role, you will drive the hiring of top-tier talent across Europe and APAC, and help us build high-performing teams in both technical and business functions. You will own the end-to-end recruitment process, build and nurture strong talent pipelines, and deliver a fast, high-quality hiring experience that directly contributes to our company’s growth and success worldwide.

Responsibilities:

  • Execute targeted hiring strategies to identify, and hire high-quality talent across sales, technical, and business roles.

  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand role requirements, skill needs, and success profiles.
  • Track and report key recruiting metrics (time-to-hire, pipeline quality, candidate conversion rates) to support continuous improvement.
  • Serve as a brand ambassador, ensuring candidates clearly understand the company’s mission, values, and employee experience.
  • Manage the full recruitment lifecycle—sourcing, screening, interviewing, coordinating assessments, and facilitating selection decisions.
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date candidate data in the applicant tracking system (ATS).

Requirements :

  • A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in talent acquisition, preferably in software or technology companies.
  • Fluent English communication skills.
  • Experience supporting global recruitment, ideally across Europe and APAC.
  • Proficiency with recruiting and sourcing tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, and other platforms.
  • Ability to adapt quickly, work independently, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Ambitious, results-driven, and thrives in high-growth settings.
  • Strong interpersonal, negotiation, and candidate experience skills.

Why Join JoVE?

  • You can expect compensation package competitively placed within the local market
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Facility Manager
description:
Americas Cluster Operations Team

We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. We are dedicated to delivering "last mile customer value" from our operational facilities, providing a seamless, reliable, and highly efficient service experience.

Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:

Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.

IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.

Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.

Our Core Focuses:

End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.

Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.

Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.

We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.

Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the daily operation and maintenance management of large-scale operational facilities within the responsible region, ensuring the efficient, stable, and compliant operation of their critical physical support systems (e.g., power, HVAC, fire suppression).

2. Develop and implement facility operation strategies, procedures, and emergency plans, ensuring facility operations comply with internal standards and external regulations.

3. Manage the facility operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and daily supervision, to enhance team professionalism and cohesion.

4. Lead facility capacity planning, energy efficiency management, and optimization projects, promoting sustainable operation practices and reducing operational costs.

5. Manage facility-related vendors and service providers, ensuring service quality and SLA compliance.

6. Lead or participate in root cause analysis for facility incidents, and the development and implementation of corrective actions.

7. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.g., IT, Security, Business Units) to ensure facility operations effectively support overall business objectives.

Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Automation, or a related engineering discipline.

2. Over 8 years of experience in large-scale facility operation and maintenance, with at least 3 years in a management role; experience in multinational corporations preferred.

3. Familiar with the operational principles, maintenance, and troubleshooting of critical physical support systems.

4. Proven team leadership and project management skills, capable of effectively driving complex project implementation.

5. Familiar with relevant safety regulations, industry standards, and environmental compliance.

6. Strong communication and coordination skills, problem-solving abilities, and risk management awareness.

7. Fluent in English, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

8. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications (e.g., PMP, CFM) are a plus.

9. (Plus) Familiarity with energy efficiency management and green operation practices is a plus.

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
description:
Korn Ferry, on behalf of John Deere, a U.S. multinational company and leader in the agricultural and construction machinery industry, is seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer for a position based in Indaiatuba, SP.

About John Deere & the Role

John Deere is a global technology company providing software and equipment for agriculture, construction, and forestry. With a strong presence in Brazil and Latin America for over 30 years, the company operates key manufacturing sites in São Paulo, Goiás, and Rio Grande do Sul.

For 2025, John Deere is accelerating its focus on autonomous solutions, AI, and connectivity. To support this expansion, John Deere is building a new team in Brazil to develop and scale applications that enhance digital products and services.

As a Senior Software Engineer – Full-Stack (Front-End Heavy), you will primarily contribute to the design and development of modern front-end applications using React, while occasionally working on backend services. You will also have opportunities to work with emerging technologies, including Machine Learning (ML) and Generative AI (GenAI), to enhance customer-facing applications.

You will leverage technologies like React, APIs, cloud platforms, and AI/GenAI tools to create intuitive, scalable, and secure applications that improve the customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development – Build scalable, high-performance front-end applications using React.
  • UI/UX Collaboration – Work closely with designers and product teams to deliver intuitive, customer-centric interfaces.
  • Backend Integration – Contribute to backend development when needed, with a focus on Python or Java (differential).
  • API Development & Integration – Connect front-end solutions with APIs and ensure smooth data flow across platforms.
  • Cloud & DevOps Enablement – Collaborate with DevOps teams on CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and deployment.
  • Technology Exploration – Evaluate and adopt emerging tools, including ML/GenAI, to drive innovation and improve productivity.
  • Quality & Security by Design – Apply best practices in coding, testing, and security to ensure robust and reliable solutions.

Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Deliver modern, React-based user interfaces that integrate seamlessly with backend systems.
  • Ensure front-end solutions are scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
  • Adapt quickly to new technologies and contribute across the stack when necessary.
  • Support the adoption of AI and GenAI to enhance customer-facing applications.
  • Maintain alignment with John Deere’s vision for autonomous operations, AI, and digital optimization.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Must-have: Extensive hands-on experience with React and front-end frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • Experience integrating RESTful APIs and working with backend services.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms, containers, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with a focus on user experience.
  • Collaborative mindset, willing to contribute to both front-end and backend tasks.
  • Differential: Experience with Python or Java for backend development.
  • Differential: Experience in Machine Learning (ML) or Generative AI (GenAI) projects.
  • Differential: Exposure to multi-cloud environments or full-stack design patterns.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
  • Advanced/Fluent English to collaborate in an international environment.

Location: Indaiatuba, SP

Model: Hybrid – 3x per week at the office
